hull_geometry: Organic, teardrop-shaped central body with multiple curved, rib-like protrusions that arc forward; a cluster of crystalline engine pods at the rear
materials_and_finish: Smooth, calcified texture resembling bleached coral or exoskeletal plating; no visible seams or mechanical fasteners
design_philosophy: Bio-engineered vessel that appears to have been grown; blends skeletal architecture with high-energy psionic tech
color_scheme: Mottled bone-white and tan chitinous exterior; internal energy chambers and sensory pits glow with an ethereal teal luminescence
distinctive_traits: The hull is covered in thousands of small, eye-like crystalline windows that pulse with a soft light
